items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Well, Oscar Pettiford, that's the band I was supposed to go with when I went to Troy's band... I talked to Pettiford and he only just wanted me in the band.

ctx.x: No. They had a whole family. She was a music teacher.
No, you got the wrong person. You talking about Pettiford?
Well, he was from there too. Oscar Pettiford? Yeah. I don't know the Bell.
